question: 9. Does ____________ show you things by bringing them to you or holding them up for you to see? Not just to get help, but to share?

ask_yes_followup.text: Please give me an example of something he/she might bring to show you or hold up for you to see. (If parent does not give one of the following 0 examples, ask each individually.)

evaluate_behaviors.instruction: Does your child sometimes bring you...

items.text: A picture or toy just to show you?
A bug he/she has found in the grass?
A few blocks he/she has put together?

check_intent.text: Is this sometimes just to show you, not to get help?
